purpose: Teach: ヘタ/産ま/大雨/足ら/だらし/漂う/ふるさと/悪夢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 柿のヘタ、お祖父ちゃん、よく取ってくれたな、子供の頃。
lines.en: You were so good at removing the persimmon stems when I was little, Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia. Gentle smile in the voice. Pause before 'Grandpa' — a small reaching back through time. Slow, warm pace. Slight trailing-off, like the memory is still settling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。私たち、戦時中に産まれた世代だものね、苦労したわ。
lines.en: Yes. We were born during the war, you know. We've been through so much.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No complaint, just fact — the voice of someone who has seen and survived. Quiet certainty. Slight weight on 'so much,' like the word contains decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 明日、大雨って、外出、控えようかな。
lines.en: There's heavy rain forecast for tomorrow. Maybe I should stay in.
lines.style: Soft questioning at the end, not quite decided. Gentle self-talk more than statement. Slight pause after the forecast — gauging his own energy. Steady, patient rhythm.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 体力、最近、足らないわね、お互いに、年だから。
lines.en: Our stamina's not what it used to be lately, is it. Getting older.
lines.style: Wry smile underneath. Rueful nod in the voice. Knowing, almost conspiratorial — she's gently poking fun at them both. Light, accepting pace. Not complaint, just truth between people who know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私、だらしない格好、許してもらえなかったな、母に。
lines.en: When I was young, Mother never let me get away with being sloppy. Never.
lines.style: Tender memory with a edge of old discipline. Quiet reflection. Slight firmness on 'never' — the voice remembering the rule, not the sting. Pacing even, nostalgic.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 庭から、桜の香り、漂う季節になったわね、あなた。
lines.en: The cherry blossoms are coming into bloom — their scent drifting all through the garden now.
lines.style: Warmth and presence. Noticing something beautiful and wanting to share it. Gentle, unhurried. Tender address to him. Slight lift on 'bloom,' like she's actually catching the scent as she speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ふるさと、若い頃に出てきて、もう半世紀以上だな、私。
lines.en: I left my hometown over fifty years ago when I was young. Can you believe it?
lines.style: Quiet wonder at the span of time. Reflective, almost talking to herself. Weight on 'fifty years' — genuinely astonished at how much time has passed. Slow, steady delivery. No rush.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、悪夢を見ること、減ったわ、おかげで、ぐっすり眠れる。
lines.en: The nightmares have lessened lately. I'm sleeping soundly now, finally.
lines.style: Gentle relief. Quiet satisfaction in survival and peace. Warm, almost intimate — sharing something private and good. Soft close, like a sigh of comfort. Slight smile in the voice.
